say: No Python.
zh: 没有 Python。

say: No Node.
zh: 没有 Node。

say: No curl.
zh: 没有 curl。

say: No J Q.
zh: 没有 jq。

say: Not even bash.
zh: 连 bash 都没有。

say: Just a shell.
zh: 只有一个 shell。

say: This is Ahyoo Core.
zh: 这就是 Ayu.Core。

say: A pure shell bot framework, for Q Q, Telegram, and Discord.
en: A pure shell bot framework for QQ, Telegram, and Discord.
zh: 一个纯 shell 的 SNS Bot 框架，支持 QQ、Telegram 和 Discord。

say: It runs inside a tiny busybox muscle container.
en: It runs inside a tiny busybox:musl container.
zh: 它运行在一个极小的 busybox:musl 容器里。

say: The interpreter is hush.
zh: 解释器是 hush。

say: The web server is busybox H T T P D, serving plain C G I scripts.
en: The web server is busybox httpd, serving plain CGI scripts.
zh: Web 服务器是 busybox httpd，跑的是最朴素的 CGI 脚本。

say: When a message arrives, the platform fires a webhook.
en: When a message arrives, the platform fires a webhook.
zh: 消息到达时，平台触发 webhook。

say: The router picks an adapter.
zh: 路由选择对应的适配器。

say: The dispatcher matches a rule.
zh: 分发器匹配一条规则。

say: And your handler runs. One shell function.
en: And your handler runs. One shell function.
zh: 然后你的处理器执行——只是一个 shell 函数。

say: The reply travels over raw sockets.
en: The reply travels over raw sockets.
zh: 回复通过原始套接字发出。

say: Netcat opens the TCP connection.
zh: nc 建立 TCP 连接。

say: S S L client wraps it in TLS one point two.
zh: ssl_client 为它套上 TLS 1.2。

say: And the HTTP request is written by hand, byte by byte.
en: And the HTTP request is written by hand, byte by byte.
zh: HTTP 请求则是手写的，一个字节一个字节地拼出来。

say: It covers all twenty nine Q Q endpoints.
zh: 覆盖全部 29 个 QQ 接口。

say: All one hundred sixty nine Telegram bot API methods.
zh: 全部 169 个 Telegram Bot API 方法。

say: And one hundred thirty five Discord functions.
zh: 以及 135 个 Discord 函数。

say: Plugins are just lines in a rules file.
en: Plugins are just lines in a rules file.
zh: 插件只是规则文件里的几行。

say: The built in sync plugin bridges your chats across all three platforms.
en: The built-in sync plugin bridges your chats across all three platforms.
zh: 内置的同步插件把三个平台的聊天打通。

say: And this is it, running in real group chats.
en: And this is it, running in real group chats.
zh: 这是它在真实群聊里跑起来的样子。

say: Q Q messages land in Discord.
zh: QQ 的消息落进 Discord。

say: Telegram shows up in Q Q.
zh: Telegram 的消息出现在 QQ。

say: And Q Q flows back to Telegram.
en: And QQ flows back to Telegram.
zh: QQ 再流回 Telegram。

say: One hundred forty one tests.
zh: 141 个测试。

say: Zero failures.
zh: 零失败。

say: No API keys required.
zh: 不需要任何 API key。

say: Ahyoo Core.
zh: Ayu.Core。

say: If it has a shell, it can run a bot.
en: If it has a shell, it can run a bot.
zh: 只要有 shell，就能跑 Bot。
